correction.text: the Franconian principality of Bayreuth-Kulmbach, a stand-in of two circles

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe (Cliopatria has no Bayreuth row). The page gives no area ('Area and population figures: not found') and no districts (Hof, Wunsiedel, Sparneck and Münchberg are not mentioned); a 32 km circle at Bayreuth (11.58E 49.94N) with a 20 km circle at Kulmbach (11.45E 50.10N), about 3,500 km2 together, soft. The 1541 House Treaty of Regensburg 'added smaller Unterland territories to Bayreuth' (not drawn: the page names none).

ledger.note: 21 January 1398: the principality. 'The principality arose upon the death of the Hohenzollern burgrave Frederick V of Nuremberg on 21 January 1398' (infobox 'Partitioned from Burgraviate of Nuremberg: 21 January 1398'); John III received Bayreuth.

region.text: the lands of the Bayreuth-Kulmbach line

ledger.note: 1604: the residence moves from Plassenburg (Kulmbach) to Bayreuth (infobox 'Capital: Kulmbach until 1604, Bayreuth from 1604').

20 January 1769: the line dies out. 'The younger line of the Brandenburg-Bayreuth margraves died out in 1769 with the death of Frederick Christian'; infobox 'Line extinct; inherited by Ansbach: 20 January 1769'. Bayreuth and Ansbach were then ruled in personal union by Charles Alexander (a personal union is not territory, rule 4).
2 December 1791: 'Charles Alexander signed a treaty with King Frederick William II of Prussia' selling the principality (infobox 'sale to Prussia: 2 December 1791').

certainty.note: The page gives no boundary or area; the circles are a stand-in.

notes:
Written 2026-10-25 for batch eu-09-x (1 page; budget 5, thin page). New state: Cliopatria has no Bayreuth row.

SHAPE. A 32 km circle at Bayreuth (11.58E 49.94N) and a 20 km circle at Kulmbach (11.45E 50.10N). Gazetteer names wanted: 'Bayreuth', 'Kulmbach'.

NOT SETTLED. (1) Area, boundary and acquisitions (Hof, Wunsiedel, the Unterland territories added by the 1541 House Treaty of Regensburg). (2) The page calls the territory officially Brandenburg-Kulmbach until 1806 without a date for the name. (3) The personal union with Ansbach 1769-1791 (not territory). (4) After 1791: French occupation (no year), Tilsit 1807, Bavaria 1810: Bayreuth is not listed in the Cliopatria rows between 1791 and 1810 as a separate state; Prussian and then Bavarian dossiers carry it. (5) Ansbach's page dates the annexation to 28 January 1792; this page gives only the sale date.
